value.name: Asha reveals the Tuesday filing
value.description: Asha pulls the Tuesday filing from beneath the corrected stack and places it between herself and Rosa.
evidence: Asha slid the Tuesday filing out from under the corrected stack and laid it flat between them.

value.name: Asha marks the signature date
value.description: Asha switches to Rosa's red marker and draws an X through the date in the signature block, visibly altering the page.
evidence: she set it down and reached for the red marker Rosa had left near the napkin holder, and she drew a single X across the date in the signature block, deliberate enough that the ink bled a little into the fiber of the paper

value.name: Asha returns the marked page
value.description: After marking the date, Asha slides the page back beneath the rest of the stack.
evidence: before she eased the page back beneath the others

value.name: Rosa silently watches Asha's action
value.description: Rosa watches Asha mark the page without intervening, holding back until the action is complete.
evidence: Rosa watched the X go down and did not move until it was finished

value.name: Rosa withdraws from the table
value.description: Rosa pulls her hand back, folds it into her lap, and responds with a measured statement.
evidence: then she drew her hand fully back from the table, folded it into her lap, and said, evenly, only we did.

value.name: Rosa answers Asha's implied question
value.description: Rosa's reply addresses the question Asha asked rather than the one Rosa had asked first, shifting the exchange's meaning.
evidence: because Rosa had answered the question Asha had asked instead of the one Rosa had asked first

value.name: Both recognize the marked page as an opening answer
value.description: Asha and Rosa understand that the marked page is the beginning of an answer to the other question, not its conclusion.
evidence: they both understood that the marked page underneath was the beginning of an answer to the other one, not the end of it
